tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i rgyud gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī sh+ma sha na a dhi pa ti gu h+ya tsikra tan+t+ra/ bod skad du/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ dpal he ru ka khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ dpal he ru ka sku skye ba med pa'i ngang las/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa'i sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa rnams dur khrod chen po'i dngos grub 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī badz+ra yo gi ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsungs pas/ 'jig rten dregs pa can thams cad brgyal bar gyur te/ brgyal ba sangs pa dang*/ 'khor de rnams kyi nang nas dpal dur khrod bdag po stan las langs te/ dpal chen po la 'di skad ces gsol to// kye/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad he ru ka /bskal pa snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gdug pa can rnams 'khrug pa dang*// sa bdag klu yi nad yams dar// ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrug pa'i tshe// mi rnams bsod nams longs spyod chung*// rang bsags dngos po spyad dbang med// pha dang bu 'bral longs spyod nyams// de dus bcom ldan bstan pa ni// dpa' bo bdag gis bsrung bar bgyi// zhes gsol pa dang*/ de nas dpal chen he ru kas// legs so dur khrod bdag po khyod// srog gi snying po bdag la phul// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ zhes mdongs gsol du phul lo// dur khrod bdag po'i gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// ༈ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba// dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni// dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba yi// yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ste// 'di yi sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa// dur khrod chen po gnas dag gam// lha khang la sogs dben gnas su// maṇ+ḍal mda' gang rgya phyed brtsigs// dkyil du gru gsum mtho gang bru// mi rta khrag gis chag chag gdab// zur la mchog phur re re gzugs// steng du thod pa dum gcig par// ri bong lug dang g.yag rgod sha// dkar gsum mngar gsum shing thog 'bru// sna tshogs zhal zas ma lus pa// rin chen lnga dang dar zab ras// stag gzig la sogs mi nor rnams// dngos grub blang phyir thod pa bkang*// de steng dur khrod bdag po ni// rab la rin chen lnga las byas// 'bring ni ba so'am rus pa las// tha ma sa la rin chen brdar// yar ngo'i skar ma rgyal la ni// snga dro dang po'i dus su bya// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar// dbu la rin chen sna tshogs dang*// thod skam lnga yis brgyan pa'o// brgya phyed rin chen do shal brgyan// keng rus gar byed mche ba gtsigs// phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'bar ba bsnams// g.yon pas thod khrag zhal du gsol// brkyang bskum gar gyis legs par gnas// sna tshogs sgrub rdzas steng na bzhugs// dar dkar dag la sngags bris la// bud med ma reg gser dum gnyis// de yi thugs kar gzhug par bya// de ni mi 'gyur gsang ba'i rten// steng nas dar dkar gur khang phub// sgrub pa thon nas bang mdzod sba// dus bzang mchod gtor dbul bar bya// dngos grub gang 'dod gsol ba gdab// sna tshogs 'bru la rin chen brdar// ga bur bzang drug chu yis bkru// sngar dang 'dra ba'i sku byas la// nang gi rten du gzung bar bya// dur khrod ro ras sku bris te// phyi rten dam tshig lus la bcangs// dkon mchog yi dam chos skyong la// mchod gsol dngos grub stsol bar bya// a mṛ ta dang sha lnga dang*// chang dang sna tshogs zas kyis ni// dur khrod bdag po yab yum mchod// de nas mtshams bcad bshags pa bya// yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags nas// de rjes tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang*// shū n+ya tā yis stong par bsgom// de nas bdag nyid hūm̐ las ni// he ru kar bsam mdun du ni// dur khrod bdag po yab yum bsam// gsang ba'i snying po 'bum du bzlas// oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/

de yi mtshan rtags lhas bstan no// mgon po dngos su byung gyur na// gang 'dod dngos grub thams cad 'grub// rat+na'i tshong pa byung gyur na// nor gyi dngos grub thob par nges// shing thog byung na zas rnams 'du// ba dang ma he byung gyur na// dkar thog thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur// til dang 'bras la spyod gyur na// zhing thog thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur// dung 'bud rnga brdung shin tu bzang*// nyi ma thal dang gos nag gyon// rtsod pa 'gyed dang zas ngan za// ban+de sngags pa byung gyur na// mgon po khros pas skong bshags bya// gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba// bdag nyid bsrung dang gnas bsrung dang*// yul khams grong khyer srung thabs dang*// shes rab 'phel ba la sogs pa// sngags dang ting 'dzin lha dang sbyar// gzhan gyi rigs sngags bzlog pa dang*// dngos grub la sogs gang bsgrubs kyang*// dkyil 'khor rdzas rnams gong tu bstan// ting 'dzin sngags dang rtsa ba'i sngags// sgrub pa chen po'i rtags thon nas// las tshogs nyi shu rtsa gcig po// bsgrubs na gang sgrub myur du 'grub// gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las las tshogs mdor bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// ༈ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba// gzhan gyi rig sngags bzlog pa ni// kham sa thal chen rgyu dag las// yab yum sku byas ye shes bstim// mchod gtor gsol ba gdab par bya// tshes brgyad nya stong dus gsum la// sme ba nag po'i dud pas bdug /gzas pa po yi ming rus can// 'brub khung nang du gzhug par bya// steng du sāts+tsha nag pos mnan// yungs kar thal chen dug khrag gsum// rtsa ba'i sngags dang srog sngags 'dis// a ya ma du ru tsa sha na// che ge mo yi rig sngags zlog /mā ra ya rbad/ dus bzhir thun gyis brab par bya// rig sngags zlog par the tshom med// yab yum zhal ni dgra phyogs bstan// liṅga dug shing tsher mas bsreg

/thal ba dam nyams phyogs su gtor// gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las rig sngags bzlog pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// ༈ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba// dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs chen po// dam tshig ldan pas dang du blang*// sngags dang ting 'dzin rgyun mi bcad// dkyil 'khor rdzas rnams gsang zhing sba// bud med dme can khyi dang gsum// de dag mi 'phrad dam tshig yin// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// 'bru sna tsan+dan chus byas te// rab tu gnas dang mchod pa bya// chang phud gtor ma phul nas ni// zhag bdun bar du bsgrub par bya// sku de bang mdzod phugs su gzhug /dus bzang gsum du mchod bya ste// gsol ba btab la dngos grub blang*// thun mong rdzas dang zas nor 'du// gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las dngos grub blang ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// ༈ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba// dur khrod bdag po yab yum dag /dkar gsum dag las byas gyur na// dkar gyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur// 'khar ba'i sku gzugs zhing dkyil gzhug /lo thog thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur// thab 'og mda' gang 'og tu ni// gru gsum mtho gang brus la gzhug /zas kyi dngos grub ma lus 'phel// chom rkun 'ching ba'i man ngag la// chu yi gseg ma la sogs la// dbyug to'i snying po brgya rtsa bzlas// bdag dang rdzas la phyogs bcur gtor// chom rkun 'ching bar gsol ba gdab// mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon phyogs bzhi nas// yab yum gar byed 'gro bar bsam// gnas su phyin te ting 'dzin lhod// de yis 'jigs pa kun las thar// rgyun du srog gi snying po bzlas// lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs// gtor mas dkon mchog mchod par bya// de 'og chos skyong yab yum mchod// rtsa ba'i sngags la dur khrod kyi// bdag po sha za yab yum khyed// i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi// zhes pa lan lnga dag gis dbul// gsol nas phrin las ci bsgo bya// keng rus gzugs can khro bo yi// phyag g.yas thod dbyug g.yon zhags pa// bsnams pa shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku// cha byad can gyis stong gsum gang*// thams cad zil gyis gnon byed cing*// yan lag dbang po bcings par bsam// zhing lpags stag lpags gang rung la// sku bris dpung pa g.yon par gdags// mthong ba'i mi rnams dbang du 'gyur// dur khrod ras la sku bris la// dmag dpon spyi bor btags pa na// gsang sngags 'bum bzlas 'khrug pa rgyal// tsan+dan shing ngam shug pa la// dri bzang dag gis sku bris te// sgo steng bcug na rims nad srung*// dur khrod ras la bris nas ni// dkyil 'khor steng du bla bre bya// rang gzhan gnyis kyi bar chad srung*// gser gyis bris pa'i yab yum sku// pha ma gnyis la bsnol mar gdags// lte ba bsgyur bas rigs brgyud 'phel// yab yum sku ni rgyab yol nang*// sbas na tshogs rdzas 'khor g.yog 'du// snying ga hūm̐ la sngags kyis bskor// 'od 'phros sems can sgrib pa sbyangs// brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig bzla// shes rab 'phel bar the tshom med// bdag gzhan lam du zhugs pa'i tshe// yungs kar dag la nyer gcig bzla// steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du// yab yum gnyis kyis gang bar bsgom// byi ba brgya yang rdugs par 'gyur// thal chen thar nu re lcag dang*// thang phrom nyungs kar lnga po la// rtsa ba'i sngags ni khri phrag gcig

/bzlas pa bye ma dang bsres la// zhing la gtor na lo legs 'byung*// srung skud mdud pa nyer gcig la// sngags ni brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas// gang la btags pa srung bar 'gyur// stag gzig la sogs gcan gzan gyis// bdag la sogs la gnod gyur na// sha ba'i rwa yi khyi len khar// mthing gi shog bu sngon po la// gser gyis yi ge lnga bris te// mun pa'i gling du sbas gyur na// gcan gzan gdug pa kha 'ching 'gyur// oṃ gcan gzan kha chings/ gzan gzan kha sdoms/ rtsa ba'i sngags la btags pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ 'di la the tshom bya mi dgos// dar dkar gro ga shing shun la// dam nyams bu chung ming bris te// mtha' la rtsa ba'i sngags gyis bskor// gcan gzan wa yi thod pa ru// gdol pa'i snying khrag dam nyams kyi// dri ma gang rnyed thod par blugs// bdag nyid dur khrod bdag po bsgom// ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug la bstim// gcan gzan stag gi mche bas dkrug /zhag bdun gyis ni las rnams 'grub// che ge mo'i bu mā ra ya/ mā ra ya rbad/ 'di yi dam tshig rten du ni// sri'u gso bar mi bya'o// srung ba'i 'khor lo zhal las shes// sngags bzlas dkrugs na ling thog sel// rtsub pa'i rtsa ba dkrugs pa'i brun// byang tshwa 'bru mar la sbyar bas// lpags nad ma lus sel bar byed// gzhan yang yon tan bsam mi khyab// gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las las tshogs rgyas pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// ༈ /de nas dpa' bo chen po des// bdag gi las rnams gang bsgrubs kyang*// gdung ba chen po'i skad kyis ni// bstod cing bskul ba 'di skad do// hūm̐/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog nas// keng rus thod pa'i gur khang nas// rak+ta'i rba klong dkyil 'khor nas// mi ro bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni// gti mug spang phyir keng rus sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar// zhe sdang 'joms phyir thod dbyug phyar// 'dod chags mtsho skem thod khrag btung*// g.yas pa'i thod dbyug 'bar ba yis// dam nyams dgra bo'i klad pa 'joms// g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis bkang*// dgra dang bgegs kyi snying khrag 'thung*// 'bar ba'i keng rus mche ba gtsigs// dug gsum rtsad nas gcod par byed// dbu la rin chen prog zhu gsol// dngos grub kun gyi gter dang ldan// mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal byas// dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod pa yin// sku la rin chen sna tshogs brgyan// sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster// gnyis med shes rab yum chen mo// rgyan dang cha lugs yab dang mthun// 'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum sku// brkyang bskum gar gyis gdug pa 'dul// gad mo sgrogs shing khros thabs tshul// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod cing*// dam tshig can la dngos grub ster// shes rab 'phel ba'i dbang phyug ste// rig sngags zlog pa'i mthu bo che// rang rtags srog snying sgra sgrogs shing*// dpal ldan yab yum thugs rje can// khyod kyi sprul pas gar yang khyab// rtsa gsum lha gnas man chad nas// na rag dmyal khams yan chad du// sprul pa bye ba dpag med 'gyed// lha srin sde brgyad khyod kyi 'khor// stong phrag brgyad cu khyod kyi bran// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di// khro rngams stabs kyis bzhes su gsol// dgra bgegs 'dul phyir mthu ma chung*// rnal 'byor skyong phyir thugs ma ring*// gdug pa 'dul phyir bang ma zhan// bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra// g.yab ba'i tshe na spyan ma rtul// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol// bsrung ba'i 'khor la skyabs ma chung*// 'gro ba srungs shig thugs rje can// bdag gis mchod cing bstod pa'i tshe// dkor khang srungs shig bar chad sol// yon bdag bsrung zhing skyob pa dang*// rnal 'byor bsam pa sgrub pa dang*// chos skyong thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// bsod nams dpag med bskyed pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam bzhin du phrin las mdzod// gtor ma byin brlab bka' bsgo bya// slob mas maṇ+ḍal yon du phul// gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las bka' bsgo bstod cing bskul ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o//

༈ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba// de nas dpal chen he ru kas// gsang ba snying gi rgyud 'di ni// dur khrod bdag po khyod la gtad// dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs// dam tshig can la dngos grub byin// dam nyams rnams la chad pa chod// ces gsungs nas 'khor thams cad rjes su yi rangs te chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang la bzhugs so// gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las yongs su gtad pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// bla ma bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta las brgyud cing*/ 'dzim lo tsā bas bsgyur ba rdzogs so// ༈ /dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung bai ros mdzad pa bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ sh+ma sha na a dhi pa ti swa dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ dur khrod kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// dur khrod bdag po sgrub 'dod na// dur khrod chen po'i gnas dag gam// lha khang la sogs dben gnas su// bkra shis pa yi sa dkar la// maṇ+ḍal mda' gang brtsig par bya// dkyil du gru gsum mtho gang bru// dmar po khrag gis chag chag gdab// zur la mchog phur re re gzugs// steng du thod pa dum gcig par// ri bong lug dang g.yag rgod sha /dkar gsum mngar gsum shing thog 'bru// sna tshogs zhal zas kun gyis bkang*// rin chen lnga dang dar zab ras// stag gzig la sogs mi nor rnams// dngos grub blang phyir blug par bya// de steng dur khrod bdag po ni// rab ni rin chen lnga las bya// 'bring ni ba so rus pa la// tha ma sa la rin chen brdar// skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par ni// snga dro nas ni brtsam par bya// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar// dbu la rin chen rgyan dang ldan// thod pa lnga yis dbu la brgyan// thod pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas// rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan// keng rus gar byed mche ba gtsigs/

zhal gdangs shing*/ /g.yas na thod gnam 'phyar/ dbyug 'bar ba thogs// g.yon pa thod thugs kar bsnams/ khrag zhal du gsol// brkyang bskum gar gyis legs par gnas// sna tshogs rdzas kyi steng na bzhugs// dar dkar dag la sngags bris la// bud med ma reg gser dum gnyis// de yi thugs kar gzhug par bya// de ni mi 'gyur gsang ba'i rten// steng du dar dkar gur khang phub// sgrub pa thon nas phugs su bcang*// dus su mchod gtor chen po 'bul// sna tshogs 'bru la rin chen brdar// ga bur bzang drug chu yis bkru// sngar dang 'dra ba'i gzugs byas la// sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor steng du ni// nang gi rten du gzugs par bya// dur khrod ro ras dag la ni// sngar dang 'dra ba bri byas la// phyi yi rten du lus la bcang*// dkon mchog yi dam chos skyong la// mchod pas mnyes na dngos grub nye// a mṛ ta dang sha lnga dang*// chang dang sna tshogs zas kyis mchod// de nas mtshams bcad bshags pa dang*// yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags nas// snying rje tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom// shū n+ya tā yis stong par bsam// de nas bdag nyid hūm̐ las ni// he ru ka'am yi dam bsgom// yab yum mdun du bskyed byas te// mchod bstod gtor mas mnyes byas la// gsang ba'i snying po 'bum du bzlas// oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ zhi ba la shān+tiṃ ku ru/ rgyas pa la puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ dbang la wa shaṃ ku ru/ drag po la mā ra ya phaṭa/ srung ba la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru zhes spel lo// de yi mtshan rtags lha yi ston// mgon po dngos su byon na rab// dngos grub bsam pa thams cad 'grub// dung 'bud rnga brdung grags pa thob// shin tu bzang bar bshad pa yin// rat+na'i tshong pa byung gyur na// nor gyi dngos grub thob par nges// ba dang ma he byung gyur na// dkar thog thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur// til dang nas la spyod gyur na// zhing thog thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur// de rnams 'bring gi rtags yin no// shing thog byung na zas rnams 'du// de ni tha ma'i rtags yin no// gzhan yang yon tan bsam mi khyab// nyi ma thal dang gos nag gyon// rtsod pa 'gyed dang zas ngan za// ban+de sngags pa byung gyur na// mgon po khros pas skong bshags

bsnyen pa bya/ bya// dam tshig bsrung ba mchog tu gces// gtor ma mi gshegs gta' ru bzung*// dkyil sgrub pa ni/ 'khor rdzas dang rten rnams la// ting nge 'dzin dang rtsa sngags bzlas/ /nang rten gsang rten rnams mdzod phugs su sba mis ma mthong bar gsang ba dang sba ba gces so/ sgrub pa chen po'i rtags thon nas// las tshogs nyi shu rtsa gcig bud med spang po// bsgrubs na gang sgrub myur du 'grub// gsad pa'i las kyang de bzhin no// man ngag ldan pas bsgrub par bya// rgyun du srog gi snying po bzlas// lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs// dang po mchod gtor dkon mchog mchod// de 'og chos skyong yab yum mchod// ma hā kā la sma sha na i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lngas phul gsol bar bsam// phrin las gang dgos 'grub par 'gyur// dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs bla ma bai ros mdzad pa'o// 'dzim lo tsā bas bsgyur ba rdzogs so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad bla ma bai ro'i man ngag bzhugs so// dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// gang dag rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis// bdag gzhan bsrung dang bzlog pa dang*// bsod nams spel dang dngos grub ster// de dag sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa// dur khrod la sogs dben gnas byi dor bya mtshams bcad/ su// maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor bshams nas ni// dang po rang nyid yi dam lha// sgrub thabs gzhung bzhin bsgom par bya// dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar// g.yas pas thod dbyug nam mkha' la 'phyar/ 'bar ba thogs// g.yon pa thod thugs kar/ pa khrag gang gsol// 'bar ba'i keng rus mche ba gtsigs// brkyang bskum gar gyis gdug pa 'dul// 'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum bsgom// oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this

srung na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru/ bsnyen pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bya/ swā hā/ tshar gcig brjod pas bdag nyid srung*// tshar gnyis brjod pas gzhan srung 'gyur// tshar gsum brjod pas grong srung 'gyur// tshar bdun brjod pas shes rab 'phel// brgya rtsa brgyad brjod yul 'khor srung*// de nas rig sngags bzlog pa ni// dur khrod thal chen blangs nas su// chos skyong yab yum sku bzhengs nas// spyan 'dren rab tu gnas par bya// brgyad dang bco lnga gnam stong la// sme ba gu gul yin/ nag po'i dud pas bdug /rig sngags zlog ces gsol ba gdab// des ni rig sngags zlog par 'gyur// dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa// 'brub khung mtho rgya dang dpangs su/ gang khrag gis byugs// zur gsum nang du mchog phur gsum// btsugs pa'i kha la thod mtshan bzang rin po che'i steng*/ pa bzhag /kha zas sna tshogs mchog gis bkang*// 'bru sna sman dang rat+na brdar// mdun dang zur la ba liṃ bzhag /dus drug dag la chang bu gso// gtor ma mi gshegs gta' ru bzung*// zhag bdun bar du smra bcad bya// dam tshig bsrung ba mchog tu gces/ bud med mi gtong*/ /sgrub pa thon nas dngos grub ba liṃ la rol/ blang*// zhag bdun lon pa'i nang par ni// dpal ldan yab yum gus pa yi// tshul gyis dngos grub drangs par bsam/ /zhing gtor ma'i steng nas zas blangs la btang ngo*/ /rgyun gtor gnyis po gtsang sar bskyal// de nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// sna tshogs 'bru la rten bcas la/ byas nas su// bang mdzod bcug la gsol ba gdab// de yis 'bru rnams 'phel bar 'gyur// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// rat+na sna tshogs dag las lug ma sogs/ bya// zhing dkyil bcug na lo legs 'byung*// thab 'og bcug na yo long 'du// gser dang dngul gyis bris pa ni// rab gnas byas la chu ra'i zhabs// sbas na zas kyi spyan gzigs 'gyur// tā la dag gi lo ma la// dur khrod bdag po'i sku bris la// gang gi mgul du btags gyur na// de la thams cad dad par 'gyur// sna tshogs rat+nas sku

g.yu zhes pa'ang snang*/ bris la// rab gnas byas la dpung par gdags// yid la bsam pa thams cad 'grub// tsan+dan gla ba dri bzang gis// sku bris rab gnas mchod par bya// sgo steng btags na nad rnams srung*// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// gsum du byas la rab gnas bya// pha la gcig btags ma la gcig /bu tsha la gcig gdags par bya// chung sri chings shig gsol ba gdab// sri'u gso bar bya ba'o// ras la bris la rab gnas bya// bla re byas la gsol ba gdab// de yis bdag gzhan bar chad srung*// gser gyis sku bris mgul du btags// de yis rigs brgyud 'phel bar gyur// nang par tshar bdun yi dam bya// de yis shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur// yungs kar dur khrod thal chen sngags// zhing la sogs pa kun la gtor// gar stabs can gyis gang bar bsam// de yis gdug pa kha 'chings 'gyur// ras bal skud pa dkar po re bal skud pa nag po la// zhes pa'ang snang*/ la// sngags la mdud pa nyer gcig bya// phyugs la btags na 'gab 'phel 'gyur// dur khrod srung ba'i man ngag ni// lha khang la sogs sa blangs la// gsang sngags brgya dang rtsa brgyad brjod// phyugs la sogs pa'i lhas su gtor// srung ba'i 'khor lo gong bzhin no// chom rkun bcing ba'i man ngag ni// chu yi gseg ma la sogs la// sngags ni brgya dang rtsa brgyad brjod// bdag dang rdzas dang phyogs bcur gtor// mdun dang rgyab kyi phyogs re nas// lha gnyis gar byed 'gro bar bsam// chom rkun chings shig gsol ba gdab// gnas su phyin tshe ting 'dzin lhod// de yis 'jigs pa kun las thar// rgyun du srog gi snying po bzlas// lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs// gtor mas dkon mchog mchod par bya// de 'og chos skyong yab yum mchod// rtsa ba'i gsang sngags nyid la ni// shrī dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po chen po/ sha za chen po gtor ma zo zo/

gsol gsol/ sma sha na a dhi pa ti/ ma hā pi shā tsi ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bdun bzlas la gsol bar bsam// shin tu gsang la bsgrub par bya// gzhan yang yon tan bsam mi khyab// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// dar dkar dag la bris nas su// dmag dpon mgo la gdags par bya// des ni dmag rnams srung bar 'gyur// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// mar la byas te sgrom du bcug /thams cad phul la gsol ba gdab// de yis dkar rnams 'phel bar 'gyur// gzhan yang gsang sngags dag la ni// gang 'dod sham bu bsgyur la gdags// bla ma bai ro'i man ngag*/ shin tu zab/ zhal gdams yod/ maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /dpal ldan sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs las tshogs zhal gdams dang bcas pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul ni/ zla ba yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi gang rung gnyis la/ mkha' 'gro phyi nang mnyes pa'i mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad sta gon bya/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi rten maṇ+ḍal mda' gang pa gru bzhi'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su/ lag len bzhin rin po che'i rten kha sprod bri/ de'i steng du mchog rkang gi khri'u la rin po che'i snod du dpal bshos sha khrag sna tshogs dang*/ dar dkar po'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa bzhag de'i steng du yab yum gyi tsaka li'am/ thang sku gang yod bzhugs su gsol/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mthar mchod pa sna tshogs dang*/ kha zas sna tshogs gang 'dzom bshams la/ phye ma red kyi tshe/ dpon slob 'khor bcas gral la 'khod de/ rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rim gnyis mchod gtor sngon du 'gro bas/ chos skyong yab yum bskyed/ gtor ma 'bul zhing mchod bstod bya/ gsol ba btab la bsnyen pa cung zad kyang dbul/

de nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gam/ rnal 'byor bla med gang rung gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pa'i slob ma dam tshig dang ldan pas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum byed du gzhug dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med cing*// yi dam lha yi ngo bo nyid// bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje yis// byin gyis brlab pa stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ slob ma chos skyong yab yum bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas chos skyong yab yum bsam gyis mi khyab pa bkug slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu nas/ yab yum gyi mkha' nas chos skyong yab yum dpag tu med pa'i skur gyur nas slob ma'i lus la thim par mos la/ sngags la/ pra we sha ya hūm̐ āḥ ā we sha ya hūm̐ āḥ zhes mang du bzlas shing dril bu dkrol la byin dbab/ de lta bu dmigs pa dang bcas pa lan gsum mam bdun gyi bar du bskyar nas dbab/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la/ sngags gong bzhin bzlas shing dril bu dkrol/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐ āḥtiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod/ slar yang gtor ma de gsos nas bdud rtsi bran/ byin gyis brlabs la phul nas/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa/ slob ma 'di dag la 'go bar mdzad de sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang gi las// bsad bskrad dbye rmongs rengs la sogs// ji ltar bsgo ba'i las sgrub cing*// sangs rgyas dam tshig rjes dran mdzod// ces pa'i rjes la/ sngags bzlas shing dril bu dkrol/ gtor ma mgor bzhag dam bzhag lan gsum bya ste dam bsgrag gtor ma maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhag mdun du bskyed pa'i chos skyong yab yum gyi thugs ka nas sngags 'phros/ slob ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par bsams la sngags kyi rjes zlos lan bdun nam nyer gcig gi bar du bya/

rjes gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang yon 'bul/ de'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa slob ma la rgyas par sbyin/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyod/ mjug gi cho ga rnams gzhung bzhin bya/ bris sku dang tsaka li yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma dngos grub blang ba'i phyir bcud zos la dben par bzhag yang na dgra'i phyogs su 'phang*/ dpal dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang gi tho bla ma'i gsung bzhin dpal g.yu mkhar mo sgrol ma lha khang du bris pa'o// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ pad+ma badz+ra/ shrī badz+ra rā hu la/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ dzñā na sid+dhi/ dpal dam tshig rdo rje/ 'chi med blo gros bzang po/ bai ro tsa na/ khams pa rgwa lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ bla ma yar sgom pa/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ bla ma mkhan chen seng ge bzang po'o// ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen pa/ mchod gtor bsdus pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gam/ rnal 'byor bla med gang yang rung ba'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gang zag la/ slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ thog mar 'di'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin te/ de nas nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ sngon du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang srung 'khor/ yi dam gyi sgom bzlas ci nus byas la/ yi dam dang chos skyong che chung gi mchod gtor gyi rjes la/ sngon du 'di'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ yang na sngon du chos skyong bskyed na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las e chad pas nam mkhar yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ sum̐ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab/

ram̐ las nyi ma/ sum̐ las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang*/ de'i nang du pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis pad+ma'i gdan/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis zla ba'i gdan gnyis su gyur/ gdan gyi steng du/ sa bon hūm̐ dang am̐ las dung dang mgron bu hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa las/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ keng rus shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas thod skam gyi dbyug pa nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ phyag g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar bsnams shing zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums pa g.yon pa'i brla la brten pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang snyan chas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab yum/ 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba gnyis su gyur te/ de gnyis kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ u rgyan nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che// phrin las rnam bzhis don mdzad pa// dad ldan dam tshig chen po yi// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// shrī sma sha na a dhi pa ti e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dang*/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pas dbu brgyan/ de la ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las kun// ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// 'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster// dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod// ces pas bstod/

oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis ji ltar bka' bsgos pa dang dam tshig las ma 'da' bar/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pas bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas dang*/ sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa dang*/ tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel zhing*/ chom rkun thams cad bcing ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las bcol/ gtor ma sha khrag dang dar dkar po'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa nang mchod chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ stong pa/ āḥthod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ hūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ hoḥs ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par mos la/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam/ zhes mos pa la/ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ shrī sma sha na a dhi pa ti ma hā pi shā tsi ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul bas gsol te dgyes par bsams la/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ nang mchod yod na 'thor zhing*/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khaṃ this swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa zhes sogs gong bzhin phrin las bcol/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las kun// ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// 'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster// dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod// rnam dkar keng rus dag pa'i gzugs// phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med par// gang la ci 'dod dngos grub kun// nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod// yang dag lam la nyer gnas te// lus can bde la 'god mdzad cing*// srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las skyob// phan bde kun stsol khyod la bstod// gang gis khyod sgrub khyod mchod na// dam bcas ji bzhin nyer dgongs nas// ji ltar gsol btab ji bzhin du// bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho dang*// dngos grub kun 'byung dam rdzas kyis// dpal ldan bstan srung 'khor bcas mchod// phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod// ces pas bstod/

sngags bzla bar 'dod pas/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi chos skyong lcam dral la phog thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dang am̐ las sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bkug nas bdag la stsal/ chom rkun la sogs pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad par mos nas/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ zhes ci mang du bzlas pa'i mthar/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod bstod gsol gdab gong bzhin bya/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang zhing*/ bris sku sogs rten yod na de la bstim/ med na badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab spyi ltar bya/ khyad par du lam bsrung bar 'dod na/ snga dro 'gro khar yab yum la gtor ma byin la/ chom rkun chings shig par gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma dgra phyogs su btang*/ rang yi dam du gsal btab nas gseg ma'am/ bye ma gtsang ma la/ rtsa sngags la chom rkun ban+dha ban+dha/ zhes btags pa mang du bzlas la 'gro ba'i phyogs dang*/ phyogs thams cad du gtor zhing*/ rang dang 'khor g.yog nor rdzas kun la gzhan gyis ma tshor bar cung zad phog par byas nas/ rang 'khor bcas kyi mdun rgyab tu chos skyong yab yum sku che zhing rags pa rngams pa'i sku las de 'dra ba mang po 'phros/ g.yas pa'i dbyug pa klad la bskor bas dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du rlog par byed pa/ g.yon pa'i zhags pas gnod byed kyi yan lag sdom pa/ rnam shes dang dbang po thams cad rmugs shing nyams par byas par mos nas/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ ma hā tha nu chom rkun ban+dha ban+dha swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing rang gis thog mar sna drangs te 'gro /de nas ci bde bar bya/ des lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs par nges shing*/

btsan sar phyin pa dang ting nge 'dzin rim gyis klod do// gzhan la lam srung ster na/ man ngag sbyin pa'am yungs kar la sngags ci mang bzlas pa thum dkar po byas pa dang*/ sngags bris pa la sham bur 'chang ba po la chom rkun rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes bris pa la chos skyong bskyed bstim byas pas yungs kar gyi thum bu dang lhan du lus sam mgul du btags pas lam gyi bar chad nges par srung zhes gsung*/ gzhan las tshogs mang po mchis pa rnams bla ma bai ro tsa na dang*/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i gsung rab las shes par bya'o// dpal dur khrod bdag po'i mchod gtor mdor bsdus pa man ngag dang bcas pa bla ma rje btsun chen po las bla ma yar sgom se bo dang*/ bla ma dam pa rgyal tsha lung mang po khu dbon las brgyud pa/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis las dang po pas bskul ba'i ngor/ dam pa mang po'i dben gnas bsam gling bde ba can du shing pho byi ba'i lo zla ba bzhi pa'i nyer lnga chos kyi rje pas dus byin gyis brlabs pa'i nyin sbyar ba dge'o// ༈ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ pad+ma badz+ra/ shrī badz+ra rā hu la/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ dzñā na sid+dhi/ dpal dam tshig rdo rje/ 'chi med blo gros bzang po/ bai ro tsa na/ khams pa rgwa lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ bla chen yar sgom/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin chen seng ge bzang pos/ bdag yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// bdag po bla ma chen po 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma/ sgom chen shākya blo ldan/ rje btsun mai tri pa chen po/ spyan snga mi pham chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag byams pa kun dga' la'o// bla ma gzungs kyi dpal ba las 'di'i rjes gnang dang las tshogs sgrub thabs sa skya pa'i bla ma gong mas mdzad pa yongs su tshang ba thob pa'i thob yig zur na yod do/

bla ma gan pa ba las bla ma dman ye shes dpal nas zhus/ de la bdag gis lung 'ga' zhig kyang thob bo// ༈ /dpal ldan bde mchog lha tshogs dang*// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po yi// gdams pa gzhung dang mi 'gal ba// bla ma'i zhal nas gsungs pa bzhin// phyin ci ma log ji lta bar// zin bris gsal bar bri bar bya// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*// dur khrod bdag pos bzod par mdzod// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i sgo nas bdag gzhan bsrung ba la gsum ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po bsnyen pa ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas su song la/ phyags dar la sogs pa yid 'jug par byas la/ gnas der rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal mda' gang ba cig legs par byas pa'i dbus su zlum po khru gang pa cig bya/ de'i dbus su rin po che'i rten zhal sprod cig bri/ de'i steng du dbus dang phyi ru nas kyi tshom bu dgu dgod/ tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du mañdzi'am mchog rkang gi khri'u byas pa'i steng du/ ka pā la mtshan ldan gyi nang du dpal bshos dang*/ sha khrag sna tshogs pas bkang ba'i rten gtor gcig bzhag chang phud kyang blugs/ de'i nang du nor bu gnyis bzhag la/ de'i steng du yab yum gyi sku gnyis kyang bzhugs su gsol/ rgyun gtor gcig kyang mdun du bzhag gzhan yang dkon mchog gi mchod gtor dkar gsum mngar gsum las byas pa 'byor tshad bshams te/ mtshams dam par byas la rang stan bde ba la bsdad de/ sems bskyed dang ldan pas rang bde mchog gam yi dam gang byed du bskyed la/ mtshams gcod drag tu bya/ srung ba'i gur khang phub ste/ me ri rdo rwa dur khrod gzhal yas khang du bsgoms la/ bla ma dkon mchog yi dam rnams la mchod gtor phul la/ sgrub pa 'di la bar chad mi 'byung ba dang*/ myur du 'grub pa'i gsol ba gdab bo// de nas rten gtor de sha khrag gi ri bo la bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po cig tu bsam mo// de'i steng du nor bu gnyis dang sku'i rnam pa las chos skyong yab yum gnyis skad cig gis wal gyis bskyed/

de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros te/ rgya gar yul gyi nub phyogs au ḍ+yān gyi dur khrod nas yab yum spyan drangs la bstim/ de nas mchod gtor sha khrag las byas pa mang du phul nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas bsnyen pa bya ste gong ltar dus bzhir bskyed bstim bya zhing mchod gtor dbul/ de ltar zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgrubs pas 'grub ste gsang bar bya'o// de nas rten gtor gtsang sar dbul/ nor bu gnyis dang sku tshags bya/ bsnyen pa'o// de nas dngos grub bsgrub pa ni/ zhes pas de'i sgrub pa bya ba ni/ sngar gyi dkyil 'khor de'i steng du gru gsum rgya dang dpangs su mtho gang pa cig bya/ de'i phyi nang khrag la sogs pas dmar por byugs/ de'i zur gsum du mchog phur gsum gzugs/ de'i khar thod pa mtshan ldan cig gi nang du zas rnam pa sna tshogs pas bkang la bzhag gzhan yang 'bru sna dang rgun 'brum la sogs te shing thog sna tshogs kyang de'i nang du blugs/ rin po che sna tshogs kyang der bzhag de'i steng du rang gang dga' ba'i kha zas sna tshogs bzhag de'i steng du gong gi nor bu dang sku bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor gyi zur gsum mdun dang bzhir gtor zan changs krad bdun bdun pa re bzhag pa'i nang du khrag re blugs pa bzhi yang bzhag go /gzhan yang bla ma dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang*/ yi dam lha'i gtor ma dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor tshad bsham/ de ni dkyil 'khor dang rdzas kyi bca' gzhi bkod pa'i rim pa'o// de nas stan bde ba la kha nub tu bltas nas bsdad/ bdag nyid yi dam lha'i ting nge 'dzin du zhugs la mtshams bcad nas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i gur khang phub ste/ bla ma dang dkon mchog yi dam la sogs pa la mchod gtor gzhung bzhin phul la/ bar chad bsrung ba la sogs pa'i gsol ba gdab/ tshogs zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i phud dang gtor ma lnga po phul/

tshogs la longs spyod/ lhag gtor gtong*/ de nas skad cig gis gtor ma de oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po sha khrag gi ri bo chen po gcig tu dmigs la de'i steng du/ phyi thod pa nang rin po che las grub pa'i dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang cig bsam/ de'i nang du sku dang mgron bu gnyis las/ chos skyong yab yum wal gyis bskyed la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas nub phyogs au ḍ+yān gyi dur khrod kyi gling nas dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum spyan drangs la/ mdun gyi de la bstim/ gtor ma bzhi po de sha khrag gi tshogs su byin gyis brlabs te bsngos la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas srog snying bgrang zhing dus drug tu changs skrad g.yon skor du re re'i nang du res bzhin du bdun bdun bzhag de yang dang po ni bzhengs la phul la/ de'i nang du khrag dang chang phud hub cig blugs/ sha khrag tu byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor sngags gsham du btags la tshar bdun gyis dbul/ de'i thun mgo'i dus su g.yas zur gyi gtor ma'ang gong bzhin du gsos la dbul lo// de bzhin du g.yon du gong bzhin du phul la/ zhag bdun du smra bcad byas te bsgrub bo// de nas zhag bdun gyi nangs par mtshams thon pa dang*/ gtor ma bzhi pa gong bzhin tshogs mchod bya'o// de'i tshe mtshams khong du bud med mi bsten no// de nas mtshams nam thon pa'i nub mo der chos skyong yab yum gyis gus pa'i tshul gyis tshogs dang dngos grub drangs par bsams la/ rten gtor steng gi rang gang dga' ba'i zas de blangs la bza'o// de nas gtor ma gtsang sar dbul/ de ni dngos grub blang bzhes kyang bya ste sgrub pa'o// rten de dag rang gi mchod khang la sogs pa'i phugs su mis mi mthong bar byas la mchod gtor bsngo/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab na rang ci 'dod pa'i grogs byed do// de nas las tshogs bstan pa ni// tshar gcig brjod pas bdag nyid srung*// zhes pa ni/

dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bdag nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin byas la dus rgyun gyi gtor ma nam gtong tsa na/ dang po yi dam la bsngo/ de steng yab yum la bsngos la bdag la bsrung ba dang bar chad bzlog par gsol ba gdab/ sngags la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa btags shing bzlas nas spyod lam thams cad du yi dam lha'i nga rgyal las ma yengs pas chos skyong yab yum 'jigs pa'i gar stabs can dpag tu med pas nyin mtshan med par bskor nas bar chad thams cad bsrungs par bsam zhing bsgom par bya'o// dgon gnas la sogs pa gang srung yang*/ chos skyong yab yum shin tu 'jigs su rung pa'i gar stabs can dpag tu med pas bskor zhing bsrungs par bsam zhing mchod gtor phul la gsol ba gdab bo// gal che na man ngag bzhin tu bya'o// de nas gnod pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// tshar gnyis zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan gyi dgon gnas bsrung bar bya ba'am/ yon bdag bsrung ba la gong ltar dmigs la gtor ma sbyin/ dmag dang nad rims dang gang bsrung bar 'dod pa'i 'di dang 'di srungs shig ces bka' bsgo bya'o// tshar gsum brjod ces bya ba ni/ grong khyer der rims nad dang dgra rkun byung gis dogs na/ grong khyer de'i mchod gtor gyi rgyu bsdus la/ gong ltar mchod pa dang gtor ma sbyin zhing gsol ba gdab/ bka' bsgo/ mis ma mthong bar sa gtsang ma la sngags la/ mis ma tshor bar grong khyer 'khor bar bskor te gtor bas chos skyong yab yum 'jigs pa'i gar stabs can dpag tu med par gyur pas bskor zhing bar chad bsal bar bsam/ dgra yin na tho rangs/ rkun ma yin na nub mo/ nad rims la dus nges pa med/ gsol ba gdab pa la sogs pa gong dang 'dra/ man ngag tu mis ma tshor bar gsang ba gal che'o// des thams cad srung bar 'gyur ro// tshar bdun zhes pa ni/ nangs par tho rangs ldang dus su rang yi dam lhar bsgom/ chos skyong yab yum mdun du bskyed la de'i zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer dang bcas pa byung ba rang gi zhal du thim pas/

blo rmongs pa dang ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal bar bsam zhing*/ sngags tshar bdun ma chag par bzlas nas/ bdag blo rno bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod na shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur ro// brgya rtsa brgyad brjod ces pa ni/ yul g.yas g.yon gzhan du nad yams byung nas rang yul du byung dogs sam/ gzhan gyis rang la dgra gshom na/ yul de'i gtor phye bsdus la/ dus bzhi'am gtan du rgyun gtor sbyin zhing*/ tho rangs nas ma chag par chos skyong yab yum 'jigs pa'i gar stabs can dpag tu med pas dbyug to thogs shing klad la bskor bas gdug pa can thams cad rdul du rlog par bsams la/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla'o// de ltar gdug pa ma zhi'i bar du bya'o// des ni zhi bar 'gyur bar the tshom med do// lar brgya rtsa brgyad ces gong du bstan te/ las gang la yang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad re dgos/ spyir sngags kyi sham bu bsgyur te gsol ba gdab pa gal che'o// de nas rig sngags bzlog pa ni// zhes pas/ dur khrod kyi thal chen dang khams bsres la/ 'bur sku legs par byas la mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal steng du bzhugs pa la mchod gtor bshams te/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis mtshams dang srung 'khor bsgom/ dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul/ gsol ba gdab/ yi dam chos skyong la gtor ma gtong*/ phrin las bcol/ 'bur sku mi dmigs pa las chos skyong yab yum du skad cig gis bskyed de spyan drangs la bstim/ mchod gtor dus bzhi'am drug tu 'bul/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas bum pa cho ga byas pa gcig gis sku de gnyis la me long du khrus gsol/ zhal bso ba'i mchod gtor cher sbyin/ rab gnas bya ste sngon du bya ba'i rim pa'o// de nas sku de dgon gnas la sogs pa'i phugs su bzhag la/ mchog phur sor brgyad pa bcus bskor la dus bzang khyad par can gsum la gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas pa'i rjes la/

rig sngags zlog cig ces gsol ba lan gsum gsum mam bdun bdun gdab/ rab zhag bdun/ 'bring gsum/ tha ma gcig tu bsgrub/ des zlog par the tshom med/ gzhan yang las sna gang la yang*/ bris sku'am 'bur sku la sogs gang yin maṇ+ḍal steng du bzhugs la mchod gtor bsham/ yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis mtshams bcad la sogs byas nas bum pa bcas te sku de la me long du khrus byas/ mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa la sogs pa gong bzhin byas la/ gang byed gnas su gzhug des kun la 'gre'o// de nas/ gzhan yang dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs// zhes pas las tshogs bstan pa ni/ 'bru 'phel bar 'dod na/ 'bru rnam pa sna tshogs kyi bag phye las yab yum gyi sku 'bur sku byas la/ de'i khong par 'bru sna blugs te maṇ+ḍal steng du gzhug rang yi dam du bsgom/ mtshams bcad/ sku bskyed bstim/ mchod gtor 'bul/ gsol ba gdab/ thun bzhi'am drug tu zhag bdun la sogs par bsgrubs la bang mdzod la sogs pa'i phugs su gzhug mchod cing gsol ba gdab bo// mar 'phel bar 'dod na/ mar la yab yum gyi sku byas la gong ltar rab gnas bya/ bskyed bstim mchod gtor 'bul/ gsol ba yang yang gdab/ mar sgrom gyi phugs su bzhag la/ mar yod tshad thams cad dbul/ spyod dus chos skyong la zhus la bya/ de la the tshom mi bya'o// yang sa bzang po la rin po che sna tshogs brdar la yab yum gyi sku bya/ rab gnas dang sgrub pa gong dang 'dra/ zhing dkyil thod pas mi sleb sar rdo sgrom gyi nang du gzhug rdo leb kyis dgab/ chus mi 'jig par byas na lo legs par byed do// lo la gdug pa thams cad bsrung bar 'gyur ro// yang 'bur sku dang rab gnas sgrub pa gong ltar byas nas/ thab khung zhabs su gru gsum khru gang brus par zhal la byas/ der bcug la rdo leb kyis kha dgab/ de'i steng du sor bdun gyi 'jim pas g.yogs/ g.yos ci byed thams cad de la 'bul bar bsam/

des zas 'du zhing thab kha longs spyod che bar 'gyur ro// yang tshon rtsi'i nang du gser brdar la/ ka ra'i shun pa la yab yum gyi sku bris la/ bskyed bstim rab gnas mchod gtor sgrub pa gong ltar byas nas chu ra'i zhabs su sbas te/ chu mi 'gro ba'i tshas bya'o// yang na chu ra khri la bzhag nas zha la byas kyang chog de mis ma rig par bya'o// des ni rang bzhin gyis kha zas bcud can gyi rigs thams cad 'du bar 'gyur ro// yang ka ra'i shun pa'am/ tā la'i lo ma la yab yum gyi sku tshon gang pa tshon gyis bris nas/ bskyed bstim rab gnas mchod sgrub gong ltar byas nas mgul tu btags na mi thams cad kyis mthong ba tsam gyis ma bu gcig pa'i 'du shes sam dad pa can gyis slob dpon mthong ba bzhin du 'gyur ro// yang dar dkar la yab yum gyi sku bris la/ bskyed bstim rab gnas mchod sgrub byas nas/ dmag la 'gro ba'i nangs par gtor ma byin la/ bdag gi dmag rnams bsrung ba dang*/ pha rol po'i dmag mi rnams bcing ba dang*/ bzlog pa'i gsol ba gdab/ bka' bsgo byas la dgra'i phyogs su gtor ma dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol la/ sku de dmag dpon mgo la gzugs so// rang yi dam du bsgom/ man ngag tu dar sku la mis ma reg par bya'o// de nas dmag mi lam du zhugs pa dang*/ rang gi dmag mi bsrungs shing*/ pha rol gyi dmag sna phar la bzlog cing dgra rdul du brlag par bsam mo// des ni rang gi mi mi 'chi/ go mi 'chor/ g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ro// de nas khyim du phyin pa dang*/ gtang rag gi mchod pa rgya chen po bya'o// yang ka ra'i lo ma la rin po che sna tshogs tshon rtsi'i gseb tu brdar la/ yab yum gyi sku tshon gang pa bris la rab gnas bskyed bstim mchod sgrub gong ltar byas la srung khug tu bcug la/ rang gi dpung pa la btags na yid la ci bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// yang tsan+dan dang gla ba la sogs dri bzang thams cad la tshon rtsi sbyar la/

ras sam/ gro ga'am shing leb khru gang pa la sku legs par bris la/ rab gnas bskyed bstim mchod sgrub gong bzhin byas la/ rang gi sgo steng du gzhal yas khang cig byas pa'i nang du bzhugs nas gsol ba btab na/ rang gi 'khor rnams la nad yams mi 'ong ngo*// yang ras dkar po la bris nas rab gnas bskyed bstim sgrub pa byas la/ rang gi steng du bla bre bres nas mis ma reg par byas nas mchod pa byas te/ dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol zhes gsol ba gdab bo// nges par zlog go /yang shing shun gang yang rung ba'am mthing shog la bris la rab gnas la sogs pa gong bzhin byas la/ gtso bo'am rang gi mgul du btags na don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// yang byis pa sri'u gso na gong ltar gser sku gsum bya/ rab gnas bskyed bstim mchod gtor sgrub pa gsol ba gdab pa byas nas/ gcig ma la gdags/ gcig pha la gdags/ gcig bu chung nam yod tsa na gdags/ rgyun du mchod cing ting nge 'dzin de dag gis srung 'khor gzhan bsgom/ bar bar du mchod cing gsol ba gdab bo// yang kham sa la rin po che sna tshogs brdar nas 'bur sku bya/ rab gnas sgrub pa sogs gong ltar byas la/ rgyab yol sog brag gi thad kar gyeng la brus la zhal zhal byas te/ dris byugs par sbas nas chos skyong yab yum dpag tu med pas gang nas thams cad dbang du bsdus par bsam mo// de'i zhal khebs rgyab yol na mar dpyangs nas mis mi rig par bya'o// des ni mi thams cad dbang du 'dus shing slob bu 'phel bar 'gyur ro// yang yungs kar dang thal chen la sngags zhes pa ni/ yungs kar dang g.yul gyi thal chen bsres nas mdun du bzhag la/ chos skyong yab yum mchod cing sngags mang du gdab/ zhing gi mtha' 'khor bar bskor bas yab yum gar stabs can mang por gyur nas bskor bas gdug pa can thams cad kyi kha bcings par bsam zhing gsol ba gdab/

des ni zhing la 'bu srin la sogs pa gdug pa can thams cad kyi kha bcing bar 'gyur ro// yang srung skud ras bal gtsang ma las byas pa'i mdud pa re re la yab yum zung re bstim zhing mdud de mchod gtor che bar bya zhing gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de nas phyugs la btags pas god kha mi 'ong zhing sgab 'phel bar 'gyur ro// gang 'dod pa de 'grub par mdzod cig ces gsol ba gdab pa gal che'o// yang nor phyugs la gor hon nam lhog pa'am/ lug la tal pa byung na/ lha khang gi gyo mo rag rug tu byas la/ snod thod pa'i nang du blugs la mdun du bzhag cing chos skyong yab yum la mchod gtor sbyin pa la sogs pa gong bzhin bya zhing sngags zhag gcig ci 'grub btab/ de nas gar stabs dang bcas sngags bzla zhing*/ lhas sam rwa bar gtor bas de rnams chos skyong yab yum dpag tu med pa gar stabs byed pas lhas sam rwa ba gang bar bsam/ des gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad cing bskrad par bsam/ des ni phyugs nad gang yin zhi ba dang chad par 'gyur ro// de nas lam bsrung bar 'dod na/ nangs par 'gro khar yab yum la gtor ma byin la bka' bsgo/ gsol ba gdab/ rang 'gro phyogs su gshegs su gsol/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas chos skyong yab yum sku che la yan lag rags pa shin tu 'jigs pa rngams pa'i sku bskal pa'i me rlung 'tshubs pa ltar byung bas/ dpag tshad mthong ba'i sa tshun chad du chom rkun dang*/ gnod byed thams cad bsad pa dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ bcing pa dang*/ mig bkab pa dang*/ rdul du brlag par bsam zhing*/ gseg ma'am sa gtsang ma mis ma brdzis pa blangs la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab la 'gro phyogs su gtor/ de nas mdun rgyab la sogs pa'i phyogs kun tu gtor ro// rang dang nor rdzas dang grogs kun la phog par bya/ de'i tshe smra ba bcad pa dang*/ grogs kyis ma tshor bar bya'o// de man ngag yin no// de nas yid kyis mdun rgyab kyi gzhogs re re so sor lta gnyis gnyis gar byed cing gzi brjid shin tu che bas dpag tshad tshun chad kyi jag pa dang*/

dgra rkun gdug sems can zil gyis mnan cing*/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad bcings bltabs rengs su bcug dbang po lnga stor zhing bred du bcug par bsams shing*/ sngags kyi sham la ma hā tha nu chom rkun chings shig btags la bzlas/ rang btsan sar phyin pa dang ting nge 'dzin klod do// des ni chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las thar bar byed par 'gyur ro// 'di ni gsang ngo*// chos skyong du bsten zhing mchod na bcol ba'i las rnams byed par 'gyur ro// dpal dur khrod bdag po'i zhal gdams/ bla ma bai ro tsa na'i zhal gdams so// dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po yi// lag len rim pa ji lta bar// bla ma rnams kyi man ngag rnams// bdag gis yi ger gsal bkod pas// 'di la mos shing sgrub pa rnams// bar chad med par dngos grub kun// ci 'dod par ni 'grub nas su// phyag rgya chen po thob par shog /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i man ngag lag len sa ma pa thā/ bla ma sa skya pa chen pos bsgrigs par gda' lags so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa rnams la na mo/ dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rten sku sba ba'i man ngag ni/ rin po che'am bkra shis pa'i sa la dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku byas te dri bzang byugs/ ras sam dar dkar la dri bzang gis 'khor lo rin po che zur brgyad pa bri/ dbus su oṃ/ zur brgyad la rin po che brgyad/ mu khyud la/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this rat+na ghṛ rā tsi waṃ/ che ge mo'i sems sgul sgul bya ba bri/ 'khor lo yab yum gyi lte bar gzhug rten gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bcas rnams gong bzhin byas la/ hūm̐ las e chad pa las nam mkhar yam̐ las rlung*/ ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ suṃ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab/ ram̐ las nyi ma/ bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang phod pa'i mkhar de'i nang du paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ zhes pas pad+ma'i gdan/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis zla ba'i gdan/

a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis zla ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du sa bon hūm̐ de las/ dur khrod bdag po chen po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar// phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'bar ba 'phyar// g.yon na thod pa khrag bkang gsol// spyan bgrad ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs// shin tu 'jigs shing rngams pa'i tshul// brkyang bskum gar gyis gdug pa 'dul// 'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum bsgom// rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// o rgyan nas ni spyan drangs bstim// rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya// gong ltar bsnyen sgrub byas nas ni// rang gi bang mdzod lugs su sba// des ni mi rnams g.yo ba dang*// dkor nor 'phel dang bsrung ba dang*// tshe ring bsod nams 'phel ba dang*// kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur 'gyur// 'di ni rten gyi man ngag go /sa ma pa thā// ༈ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge rnams bzhugs so// dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dam tshig ldan pa'i gang zag gis dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po sgrub pa la gsum ste/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor ro// dang po bsnyen pa ni/ dur khrod dam/ lha khang ngam/ dben pa'i gnas su/ bkra shis pa'i sa nas sa dkar po blangs te/ maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gi rgya dang dpangs su ldan pa brtsig de'i dbus su zlum po khru gang pa bri/ de'i dbus su gru gsum mtho gang bris/ khrag gis dmar por byugs/ dbus su rin po che sna tshogs bsres pa'i re khās gru bzhir bsnol/ zur brgyad pa la rin po che 'bar ba dang*/ lte bar rin po che rten sprod gnyis bri/ steng du tshom bu bcu dgod/ zur gsum gyi zur gsum la mchog phur gsum sgro'i khri steng du/ ka pā la mtshan ldan dum bu gcig pa'i nang du 'bru sna tshogs pa'i gtor ma dpal bshos can/ mtha' changs bu bdun gyis bskor ba can/ dkar gsum mngar gsum/

shing thog 'bru sna zas sna/ ri bong lug g.yag rgod kyi sha dang*/ khrag sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ gta' gtor la rin po che sna lnga/ dar zab sna tshogs/ stag ras gzig ras sna tshogs gzugs/ de'i gsang rten dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku rab rin po che/ 'bring ba so/ tha ma sa bzang po la rin po che brdar bas bya/ dar dkar la sngags bris gser la bud med kyis ma reg par dril la de'i thugs kar gzhug skar ma rgyal gyi snga dro tshar bar rab tu gnas pa byas la gzhug nor bu dang*/ dung dang*/ 'gron bu bum gnyis kyang bzhag nas/ steng du dar dkar gyi gur phub pa rnams mi 'gyur ba'i gsang rten no// 'bru sna tshogs la rin po che brdar ba/ ga pur dang dri bzang*/ bzang drug chos mgo bsdus te yab yum gyi sku byas la dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzhug pa ni nang gi rten no// dur khrod kyi ro ras la yab yum gyi sku bris/ de'i snying gar rtsa sngags la rab tu gnas par byas nas/ rang gi lus la bcang ba ni phyi'i rten/ rang gi mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi changs bu'i rgyun gtor gcig bya/ changs bu g.yon skor du bdun bdun gyis gang ba'i tshang byas la nang nub gnyis btang*/ dkon mchog dang yi dam mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma bzang ba g.yon zur du bshams/ thun mgo la dbul/ de nas mtshams bsdams la bshags pa bya/ srung 'khor bsgom/ he ru ka'am/ yi dam gang rung gi bsgom bzlas bya/ de nas dang po bla ma dkon mchog dang*/ yi dam la mchod pa dang gtor ma phul la/ sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba dang*/ myur du 'grub pa'i gsol ba gdab/ de nas rten gtor de sha khrag gi ri bo bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlab/ de'i steng gi sku de skad cig gis dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus keng rus thod pa'i gur khang nang rak+ta'i rba klong 'khyil pa'i dbus na/ mi ro bsnol ba'i gdan la/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum keng rus 'khrol ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'bar ba 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag zhal du gsol ba/ rin po che dang thod skam gyi dbu brgyan dang*/ thod pa'i do shal dang ldan pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyi gar stabs sna tshogs mdzad pa/ de lta bu'i 'khor dang sprul pa dpag tu med pa bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgya gar gyi dur khrod chen po brgyad nas yab yum spyan drangs la bstim mo// rten gtor rtags byung ba dang*/ 'bul bar khas blangs la sgrub tshe rten du bzung ngo*// rgyun gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ sma sha na a dhi pa ti ma hā pi shā tsi ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun gyis thun drug tu phul la/ changs bu bdun gyis gang ba'i tshad byas la btang*/ bstod pa byas la gang 'dod gsol ba gdab/ de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ dang sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ yab yum gyi thugs ka'i srog gi yi ge rtsa ba'i sngags yod pa bskul bas las mi bya rang dbang med par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ zhes rgyun ma bcad par bzlas te/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgrub/ gsang ba'i snying po 'bum du bzla zer yang rtags thon pa gal che ste/ 'grub pa'i rtags rab mgon po dngos su byung ste gtor ma byin nas phrin las gang bcol bsgo ba bzhin du byed de dngos grub chen po 'byung ngo*// 'bring rmi lam du keng rus kyi sku 'khrab pa dang*/ mon pa/ a tsa ra/ rgya'am/ bon po 'byung*/ gzhan yang sna tshogs 'byung ste bzang ngan brtag shes par bya'o// dung 'bud rol mo byed na grags pa che// rat+na'i tshong pa byung na nor 'phel/ ba glang ma he byung na dkar thog 'phel/ til dang nas la spyod na 'bru 'phel/ shing thog dang bza' btung ster ba rmis na zas 'du/ rgyun du 'khor ba'i rtags rmis na srung ba'i rtags 'grub bo// ngan pa ni/ nyi ma brgal ba dang*/ gos nag gyon pa dang*/

rtsod pa 'gyed pa dang*/ ban+de nag po khro ba dang*/ zas ngan za ba dang*/ mdze pho mo sogs rmis na mgon po khros pas de'i skong bshags la 'bad par bya'o// bsnyen pa thon nas rten gtor de phul/ sa gtsang sar btang*/ rten rnams mdzod phugs su mis ma tshor bar gsang ngo*// bsnyen pa'o// sgrub pa ni sngar gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du gru gsum rgya dpangs su mtho gang yod pa cig brtsigs sam brus/ maṇ+ḍal gyi phyogs bzhir gtor snod ri rab changs bu bdun gyis gang ba la sha khrag gis brgyan pa bsham/ rten gtor steng du rang dga' ba'i zas cig bzhag gzhan rten bca' gzhi thams cad sngar dang 'dra bar byed/ de nas mtshams bcad/ bshags pa bya/ srung 'khor bsgom/ yi dam bskyed rim bzlas pa bya/ mchod pa dang gtor ma sngar bzhin bsham/ mgon po bskyed pa dang*/ gtor ma sngar dang 'dra/ khyad par gtor ma bzhi po de sha khrag gi rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ yab yum la phul la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ dus drug tu gtor snod re rer chang bu re re bsnan nas byin gyis brlab nas phul bas bdun tshang ba dang*/ thun tha ma la gtor ma bsham/ srod la tshogs re bya/ de nas smra bcad byas la sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ rgyun mi chad par rtsa sngags kyi snying po drag tu bzlas shing zhag bdun bsgrub bo// zhag bdun gyi mtshams thon pa'i nub mo gtor ma thams cad phul/ tshogs bya zhing rol/ rten gtor steng gi rang dga' ba'i zas de chos skyong gis dngos grub byin par bsams la za'o// mi la mi sbyin no// gtor ma sa gtsang sar btang*/ rjes bsdu/ rten rten gtor dang bcas pa mchod khang ngam bang mdzod sogs su mis ma mthong bar sba'o// dam tshig tu/ sgrub pa'i bar la mtshams khang du bud med dang dme can dang*/ gcan gzan mi btang*/ khyad par yugs sa mo la 'dzem mo// gal te byung na sgrub pa bskyar la bya'o// gnas skabs thams cad du gtor ma dang bzlas pa la brtson par byas na/

lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs shing snying nye'o// sgrub pa'o// las sbyor ni/ las tshogs so so'i skabs bzhin shes par bya'o// ༈ /smyo 'dul na/ sha chen/ yungs kar/ gu gul nag po/ so ba/ rgya skyegs/ ldong ros/ mu zi/ ro bsregs/ thal ba rnams nad pas ma tshor bar bsregs/ rang khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis nad pa'i mdun du sol me la rdzas brgyad po bsregs pa'i dud pa phyir mi 'tshor bar byas la bdug yugs sa'i skra shad kyis nad pa'i rke nas bcings la/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pas bzung ste/ sngags bzla zhing khas ma blangs bar du lag pa g.yas pas yungs kar dang so bas brab/ sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i rnam 'gyur byung byung bya/ de ma byung na 'dre ma yin pas sman bcos bya/ 'phar ba dang*/ 'dar ba dang*/ ngu ba dang*/ dgod pa la sogs pa byung na 'dre yin pas sngar bzhin gzir cing*/ gzhan gcig la 'drir bcug kyang thub bo// zab bo// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i las tshogs bzhugs so// swa sti/ yul du rims nad byung ba la/ gtor phye bsdus la/ yab yum gyi sku la mchod gtor phul la/ rims nad zlog ces gsol ba gdab// dur khrod thal chen grong la gdab// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam// des ni rims nad zlog par 'gyur// phyugs la glo gor byung ba dang*// lug la tal ba byung pa la// dur khrod thal chen dag la ni// yungs kar yungs nag bsres byas nas// phyugs kyi lhas su gtor bar bya// des ni mi phyugs nad rnams khog/ ༈ /na mo gu ru/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal zlum po khru gang pa zhig de'i steng du rin po che gcig bris la/ de'i steng du nas spungs/ de'i steng du mañdzi'i khar rten gtor bzhag de'i steng du yang gtor ma bzhag mdun du rgyun gtor bsham/ gzhan yang dkon mchog mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ lha bsgom mchod gtor 'bul/ zhag nyer gcig bsnyen pa bya/

rgyun du gtor ma bshams la yab yum la gsol ba gdab/ dus rgyun du yi dam mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par bya/ yab yum dpag tu med pas bskor zhing bar chad bsal bar bsams la gsol ba gdab/ dgra dmag rims nad srung ba'i thabs la man ngag bzhin bya ste/ dgra la tho rangs bya/ rims la nges pa med/ de yang gong dang 'dra/ mis mi tshor bar bya/ gar stabs can gyis gang nas gdug pa can thams cad bsal bar bsam/ rgyun gtor changs skrad bdun bdun bzhag rten gtor steng du dung gnyis bzhag sha dang khrag gi ri bo dang rgya mtshor bsams pa'i steng du dung gnyis las yab yum bskyed nas bstim par bya/ rgyun gtor sngags bdun bdun la khā hi btags la 'bul lo// 'dzin gtor mi gshegs gta' ru bzung*/ dus drug tu changs bu re re bdun bdun nyi ma gcig gcig bzhin du g.yon skor bya/ lan bdun gyis gang ba'i tshad bya/ mtshams khang du bud med mi btang*/ sgrub pa'i yig chung yin no// tsakra'i rab gnas bya/ rang yi dam gyi lhar mos te/ rtsa ba'i bla mas gtso byas la bla ma rnams mdun du spyan drangs la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog dmar po/ de'i phyag rgya'i nang du chud par bsams la/ mchod pa dbul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag lam log pa las bskyab tu gsol/ chom rkun las bskyab tu gsol/ gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ rten 'brel snying po btags la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bstim/ rab gnas so// ༈ /na mo gu ru/ shin tu dben pa'i gnas nyid du// bde ba'i stan la rab 'dug ste// dur khrod sa la maṇ+ḍal ni// gru bzhi mda' gang tshad du bya// steng du zlum po khru gang bya// de yi steng du gru gsum bya// chang dang khrag gis byug par bya// zur gsum dag la mchog phur gsum// steng du mtshan ldan ka pā la// nang du kha zas mchog gis bkang*// thabs dang shes rab nor bu gnyis// sgrub pa'i rten du bcang bar bya// dkar po'i dar gyi zhal khebs can// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// dmigs pa'i rten du dgram par bya// de nas yan lag bdun pa bya// tshad med bzhi yi sems kyis sbyangs// de nas stong pa'i ngang nyid las// bdag nyid yi dam lha ru bskyed/

dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni// sku mdog dkar po 'jigs pa'i sku// spyan gsum nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bgrad// phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'bar ba ste// g.yon pa na ni thod khrag 'dzin// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs bzhugs// bdag gi mdun du bsgom par bya// g.yas su dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams bskyed// g.yon du dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams bskyed// mdun gyi bar snang dag la ni// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma yi dam rnams kyang bsam// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni// oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ tshar gcig bzlas na bdag nyid srung*// tshar gnyis gzhan srung tshar gsum grong*// tshar bdun brjod pas shes rab 'phel// brgya rtsa brjod pas yul khams srung*// stong gis yon bdag srung bar byed// de ni srung ba'i man ngag go/ ༈ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku'i mdun du mchod pa lnga bsham/ a ka ru dang*/ du ru ka dang*/ gu gul nag po dang*/ tsan+dan dmar po la sogs spos sna tshogs bsreg dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs pa'i tshogs rgya chen po bsham/ gtor ma gsum bsham/ dkyil 'khor bri/ logs bzhir g.yung drung ris re bri/ g.yung drung ris re la dur khrod bdag po yab yum bsam/ bla ma yi dam rnam gnyis bsam/ spyan drangs la yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa thams cad dbul/ srod la tshogs 'khor bla ma dang dur khrod bdag po yab yum la dbul/ rang ngoms shing tshim par bya/ gtor ma gsum po gshegs su gsol/ dus bzang rnams la mtshams bya/ nyi ma shar ba dang tho rengs la bya/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams las 'od zer 'phros/ bdud rtsi dkar dmar gnyis byon nas rang gi lce thog tu thim par bsam/ sngags nyer gcig bgrang*/ yab yum gyi sku sor gcig pa bris la nu ma g.yon pa'i thog tu gdags/

ru dra ti ra bam̐ gyis ro'i gdan/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'jigs shing rngams pa/ brkyang bskum gar gyis gdug pa 'dul ba 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis u rgyan nas spyan drangs la bstim/ mchod gtor dang bsnyen sgrub sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar byas nas/ mdzod phugs su sbas nas gsang ngo*// des ni mi rnams g.yo ba dang*/ nor 'phel zhing 'khor bcas srung ba dang*/ tshe ring ba dang*/ bsod nams grags pa 'phel ba dang*/ gtsug gi nor bu ltar 'gyur ro// yab yum gyi rten gyi man ngag logs su bkol ba'o// zab bo// ༈ /dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar// g.yas pa thod dbyug 'bar ba bsnams// g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang gsol// keng rus gar byed mche ba gtsigs// brkyang bskum gar gyis gdug pa 'dul// 'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum sku// thams cad ma lus skrag par byed// dgra rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// mthun rkyen sgrubs shig dpal chen po// 'gal rkyen rdul du rlog byed cing*// mi mthun 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po khyod// sngon tshe bcom ldan spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes// dam las ma 'da' da tshur spyon// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// chos pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes// chom rkun srung bar zhal gyis bzhes// mthun rkyen sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes// bh+yoḥdapal chen dur khrod bdag po ni// dbugs len bye ba 'bum phrag bdun// zo zhig dgra bo'i sha la zo// sha yi rtsig pa ri rab tsam// habs se habs se sha la zo// bh+yoḥdapal chen dur khrod bdag po khyod// 'thungs shig dgra bo'i khrag la 'thungs// hubs se hubs se khrag la 'thungs// sdang ba dgra bo'i khrag la 'thungs// bh+yoḥdapal chen dur khrod bdag po ni// 'goms shig dgra bo'i dbugs la 'goms// 'gal rkyen byed pa'i gdug pa rnams// ma lus dbang du bsdus nas /dur khrod bdag po yab yum la drag po'i dus su bstod cing bskul ba rdzogs so// ༈ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum sha za chen pos dam nyams pa bsgral ba'i thabs la dur khrod dam dben pa'i gnas su/ mi pho mo tshad rims kyis shi ba'i shul nas sa blangs la/ de la maṇ+ḍal gru gsum khru gang bya/ nang du khrag dang dur sol gyis byugs/ dur khrod sol bar rin po che brdar la khrag gis sbrus la dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku sor brgyad pa kha sbyor byas la/ dug khrag gis bsgrub bya'i ming rus bris la/ de'i bar du mgo thur du bstan pa gzhug gru gsum nang du liṅga de dang 'dra ba bris la gzhug steng du dar nag po phub/ rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig dur sol gyis byugs la gru gsum kha la srin mo 'gros su bskor/ gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa chang gis bran la cher bshams/ thun rdzas/ zangs phye/ lcags phye/ mun nag dug sna tshogs bsags/ rang yi dam du bsgom/ de'i mdun du skad cig gis dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum sku mdog dkar po dang nag po gnyis mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas khram shing g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa/ 'khor sha za'i bdag po dang bdag mo dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa gzhug gtor ma sha khrag rgya mtsho bdud rtsir dmigs la rtsa ba'i sngags bdun gyis dbul/ thal mo brdab/ phrin las bcol/ de nas thun rdzas rnams dur khrod bdag po yungs 'bru tsam mang por bsams pa'i mtshon gyis btab/ dug gis gzir/ nad kyis myos/ phye mar gtubs par bsams la/ thun brab cing*/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ che ge mo mā ra ya rbad rbad/ ces mang du bzla'o// de lta bu zla ba phyed phyed bar du smra bcad bya/ mtshan ma ni nges pa med/ cho 'phrul ci yang ston te skrag par mi bya'o// de nas liṅga dang sku de rnams dar du dril nas/

lho phyogs kyi dur stong par mnan no// lo ma 'khor bar chad pa'i las kyis 'chi bar 'gyur ro// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po sha za chen po yab yum gyi dam nyams bsgral ba drag po'i las rdzogs so// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ tsau ra rak+ṣa/ bod skad du/ jag pa srung ba'i thabs/ srung bar byed pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gi sngon dang phyi nas ni// sha med keng rus pho mo gnyis// thod dbyug thod khrag g.yas dang g.yon// gnyis ka gar byed bya ra byed// tsau ra srung zlog byed par bsam// oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ rkang 'og nas ni sa blangs la// sngags bzlas phyed ni sngon la gtor// phyed ni sum cha'i cha gcig ni// rgyab kyi phyogs su gtor bar bya// cha gcig grogs dang rdzas la gtor// sum cha gcig la yang sngags ni// brgya bzlas mdzub mos sngon la gtor// de bzhin mtheb chung rgyab tu'o// des ni tsau ra'i 'jigs pa bral// mal sngags rten yang de ltar shes// rta phyugs la sogs de ltar bya// 'di la the tshom spang ba'o// bla ma 'dzim lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o// oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ zas za ba'i dus su zan changs skrad gnyis la sngags btab pa mdun rgyab tu bskur la/ dur khrod bdag por mchod par bzhes// jag chings 'di las zab pa med do// // ༈ /lugs gcig la/ oṃ ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ zhes stong bzlas te/ mal gyi g.yas phyogs nas mis ma 'gong ba'i sa blangs nas sngags btab la mdun dang*/ g.yas g.yon/ rgyab tu gtor la/ rang gi sna drang ngo*// 'di la lag len yang yang byas te bzang po'i rtags thon/ thub nges par 'dug /// lha sa bskor ba la/ skor ra ba brgya brgya tsam la dgra yang yang byung ba la/ slob dpon shag yon zer ba zhig gis/ gdams ngag 'di shes par 'dug pas/ 'di mdzad pas skong ra ba rnams la jag pa dang rkun ma ma byung bar gda'o// kong por phyin pa la yang 'di byas pas zab par byung ba'i lo rgyus gda'o// shin tu zab bo// //
